# Tristarnex

> Tristarnex is a cybersecurity firm delivering enterprise-grade threat detection, penetration testing, vulnerability management, incident response, and security awareness training for businesses of every size. AI-assisted. Human-led.

## Services

- Threat Detection & Response — Real-time endpoint monitoring with AI-assisted triage, critical threats isolated in under 2 seconds
- Penetration Testing — Network, web application, social engineering, and red team assessments
- Security Assessment — Complete security posture review, gap analysis, and prioritised remediation
- Vulnerability Management — Continuous CVE tracking scored by real-world exploitability
- Security Awareness Training — Phishing simulations and hands-on workshops
- Incident Response — Guaranteed response time, dedicated responder, full containment and forensics

## Key Facts

- Founded: 2026
- Monitoring: 24/7 global monitoring capability
- Detection speed: <2 second AI threat triage
- Threat intelligence: 1.2M+ threat indicators from 34 global feeds
- Response SLA: Detection-to-containment 94% within 15 minutes
